winConditions.title: Reduce LP to 0
text: Each player starts with 8000 Life Points. Reduce your opponent's LP to 0 through battle damage and effect damage to win.

winConditions.title: Deck Out
text: If a player is unable to draw a card from their Main Deck when required, they lose the Duel.

winConditions.title: Alternative Win Conditions
text: Some cards have effects that declare an automatic win when their conditions are met (e.g., Exodia the Forbidden One, Final Countdown).
